newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Antonov's Dutch price set at NLG 3.39.
newsitem.headline: Antonov's Dutch price set at NLG 3.39.

text.p: The price for the flotation of British gearbox maker Antonov Plc on the New Market of the Amsterdam Stock Exchange (NMAX) has been set at 3.39 guilders or 1.08 sterling, broker Leemhuis & Van Loon said on Friday.
The offering, which was fixed at a maximum of 2.63 million ordinary shares, was oversubscribed more than twice.
The Dutch flotation price was based on Antonov's closing price on London's Alternative Investment Market (AIM) on April 24 which was 1.12 stg or 3.52 guilders.
The stock will start trading in Amsterdam today.

Earlier this month, Antonov expanded its share capital by five percent through placements of new shares with mainly Dutch institutional investors. These raised about three million sterling, the company said.
On April 11, Antonov posted a 1996 pre-tax loss of 1.76 million stg, narrowing year-earlier losses of 1.79 million stg.
